text: {"assertions":["On 2026-06-27, a latency spike issue was identified in ml/serving/batcher.py where the batcher showed tail latency far above the median in the serving histogram.","The root cause of the latency spike was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime.","The latency spike only occurred when the input request list came in empty.","The fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge to prevent the comparison issue.","The fix was submitted as PR #3614 on the fix/latency-spike-1 branch.","After the fix was applied, the latency alert remained quiet for 37 consecutive days, confirming the issue was resolved.","The codebase uses Python and the batcher tests are located in tests/ml/test_batcher.py."]}
